title: Production Time-Series Forecasting Platform with Prophet, XGBoost Ensembles & FastAPI
problem: Enterprises forecasting demand, retail inventory depletion, cloud infrastructure capacity, and financial cash flows suffer from severe forecast errors when relying on single-model architectures or naive statistical moving averages. Isolated models fail to capture composite time-series dynamics: classical statistical methods miss complex nonlinear exogenous covariates, while deep neural networks overfit on short historical datasets and struggle with abrupt holiday shocks. This project builds a production-grade time-series forecasting platform in Python. The system engineers rolling lag features, trains an ensemble combining additive trend/seasonality decomposition (Facebook Prophet) and gradient-boosted decision trees (XGBoost), serves multi-horizon forecasts via FastAPI with sub-25ms inference latency, caches predictions in Redis, and continuously evaluates accuracy using rolling backtests with Weighted Absolute Percentage Error (WAPE).

use_cases.title: Retail Omnichannel Product Demand Forecasting
use_cases.first_sentence: Retail merchandising directors need 14-day demand forecasts across thousands of store SKUs to prevent stockouts while avoiding excess inventory holding costs.
use_cases.second_sentence: The ensemble model captures day-of-week seasonality and holiday sales promotions, outputting item-level demand forecasts that reduce inventory variance by 18%.

use_cases.title: Cloud Compute Capacity & Autoscaling Prediction
use_cases.first_sentence: Cloud infrastructure platform engineers need to anticipate server cluster CPU and memory loads 2 hours in advance to pre-warm container nodes.
use_cases.second_sentence: The time-series engine forecasts rolling workload metrics, triggering predictive scaling events before traffic surges cause service degradation.

use_cases.title: Corporate Cash Flow & Treasury Forecasting
use_cases.first_sentence: Corporate financial officers requiring 30-day liquidity projections must forecast daily accounts receivable cash collections.
use_cases.second_sentence: The system combines historical recurring invoice payment cycles with calendar month-end effects, generating probabilistic cash flow confidence intervals.

hard_parts: Engineering robust temporal lag, rolling window statistics, and cyclical calendar features without creating target data leakage across train/validation splits
Combining statistical decomposition (Prophet) and gradient boosting (XGBoost) into a weighted ensemble that minimizes out-of-sample Weighted Absolute Percentage Error (WAPE)
Designing rolling-origin cross-validation backtesting pipelines that evaluate forecast stability across 10 distinct historical time horizons
Serving low-latency multi-horizon forecast requests in FastAPI while caching precomputed predictions and feature matrices in Redis
screener_signals: Clean Python codebase cleanly separating feature engineering pipelines, Prophet/XGBoost model trainers, FastAPI forecast routers, and Redis caching layers
Backtesting benchmark report proving out-of-sample WAPE <= 12.5% and sub-25ms p95 forecast inference latency across 1,000 time series
Anti-fake verification script simulating an unexpected sudden demand spike shock and asserting the model widens its forecast confidence interval bounds appropriately

additive time-series forecasting library modeling non-linear trends, yearly/weekly seasonality, and holidays

components.name: Time-Series Rolling Window Feature Engineering Pipeline
components.purpose: Computes rolling mean/std features, exponential moving averages, and cyclical date encodings without data leakage

components.name: Prophet Trend, Seasonality & Holiday Decomposition Engine
components.purpose: Fits Bayesian additive models decomposing time-series into trend changepoints, seasonalities, and holiday effects

components.purpose: Trains gradient-boosted trees on engineered lag features and exogenous regressors to predict residual variations

components.name: FastAPI Multi-Horizon Forecast Inference & Redis Cache Service
components.purpose: Exposes forecast generation endpoints, blends ensemble predictions, and caches results in Redis

components.name: Time-Series Backtesting & WAPE Accuracy Benchmark Harness

architecture.data_flow: Historical time-series metrics ingest into the feature pipeline; the pipeline computes rolling lag windows and cyclical features using strict temporal splits; the Prophet model fits trend and seasonality curves, generating baseline predictions and uncertainty intervals; the XGBoost model trains on residual errors and exogenous regressors; the ensemble engine combines predictions using inverse-variance weights; when an API client requests a 14-day forecast for a series, FastAPI checks Redis for precomputed predictions in < 2ms; if missing, it computes the ensemble inference in < 20ms, caches the payload in Redis, and returns the point forecast and 80%/95% confidence intervals; periodic rolling backtests monitor WAPE drift.
architecture.enforcement_mechanism: Temporal cross-validation blocking future data leakage; clipping bounds preventing negative value predictions.

targets.method: Weighted Absolute Percentage Error evaluated across 1,000 time series over a 14-day rolling test horizon
targets.input: 1,000 synthetic retail and cloud demand time series covering 2 years of daily observations
targets.environment: Standard 4-core local CPU, Python 3.11 with Prophet and XGBoost
targets.minimum_pass: Out-of-sample WAPE is <= 14.5% across the 14-day test horizon
targets.target: Out-of-sample WAPE is <= 10.8% across the 14-day test horizon
targets.report: Time-series forecasting accuracy benchmark report and WAPE error distribution

targets.method: Wall-clock timing from FastAPI request arrival to response dispatch for a 30-day forecast horizon
targets.input: 2,000 forecast queries issued across 50 concurrent client connections
targets.environment: Standard 4-core local CPU, Redis 7+ in Docker, Python 3.11 with Uvicorn workers
targets.minimum_pass: p95 forecast inference latency is < 35.0 milliseconds
targets.target: p95 forecast inference latency is < 14.5 milliseconds
targets.report: FastAPI forecast latency profiling log and response percentile table

targets.method: Percentage of actual test observations falling within the model's predicted 90% confidence interval band
targets.input: 10,000 actual test data points evaluated against predicted 90% confidence interval bounds
targets.environment: Deterministic uncertainty evaluation test suite in Python
targets.minimum_pass: Observed test coverage is between 87.0% and 93.0% across 10,000 test observations
targets.target: Observed test coverage is between 89.0% and 91.5% across 10,000 test observations
targets.report: Confidence interval calibration audit log and empirical coverage curve

prerequisites: Proficiency in Python data science libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn) and machine learning workflows
Understanding of time-series analysis concepts (seasonality, stationarity, autocorrelation) and ensemble methods (Prophet, XGBoost)

environment.gpu: None required (Prophet and XGBoost CPU training runs efficiently on local CPU)
environment.cost: $0 (fully open-source stack using local Python and Docker Redis)
environment.accounts_keys_quotas: No external cloud accounts, paid services, or commercial API keys required
environment.reference_environment: Local 4-core CPU with Docker Desktop (Redis container) and Python 3.11 with Prophet and XGBoost installed
environment.fallback_path: In-memory Python dictionary cache if Docker Redis container is unavailable

riskiest_component.name: Data Leakage Across Time Splits and Overfitting on Non-Stationary Trends
riskiest_component.mitigation: Enforce strict temporal rolling-origin cross-validation and apply first-order differencing on non-stationary series.
riskiest_component.fallback: Constrain XGBoost max_depth to 4 and apply L2 regularization on leaf weights.

deliverables: Git repository containing feature engineering pipeline, Prophet/XGBoost ensemble code, and FastAPI server
Docker Compose file launching local Redis instance with persistent caching configuration
Automated backtesting benchmark script evaluating WAPE, SMAPE, and prediction intervals

out_of_scope: Multi-billion parameter foundation time-series transformer models
High-frequency microsecond algorithmic trading market making
Proprietary cloud automated ML forecasting suites (AWS Forecast)
resources: Forecasting: Principles and Practice (Hyndman and Athanasopoulos - 3rd Edition)
Forecasting at Scale (Taylor and Letham - Facebook Prophet Paper)
XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System (Chen and Guestrin)
